+def _prints_as_fraction(expr):
+    """Check if ``expr`` is printed with a top level division.
+
+    Such expressions (e.g. ``1/x`` or ``1/sqrt(x)``) need to be
+    parenthesized when they appear as a factor of a denominator,
+    otherwise the printed output would be ambiguous (issue 21537).
+    """
+    return (isinstance(expr, Pow) and expr.is_commutative and
+            (expr.exp is S.NegativeOne or -expr.exp is S.Half))
+
+
